t: Does anyone know a breed suitable for lazy people? : r/dogs
s: September 25, 2022 - every dog-- even the lazy ones-- do need some exercise to keep their weight and temperaments level. at least two or three 15-minute walks a day is the bare minimum, and it honestly might even help you feel better to get more active either in preparation or because of them. elderly dogs don't need walks that are as long and tend to just lounge, so if you're still keen on the laziness aspect i think that would be your only viable option. ... Typically any dog will need a lot of enrichment and exercise, but maybe something like a Shih tzu because their purpose was to be companion dogs and they’re fluffy. However, there’s no single answer for a “breed” petfinder.com has some good articles on this and breaks things down by breed which is nice.
